sections.title: Broadcasting fee and statutory municipal charges

rows.label: Tax status: own income tax system; US federal FICA and FUTA apply
rows.value: Puerto Rico has its own separate and independent income tax system (the Código de Rentas Internas de Puerto Rico de 2011, administered by the Departamento de Hacienda). Bona fide residents pay Puerto Rico income tax on worldwide income and generally report to the IRS only income from outside Puerto Rico; US federal social security and Medicare taxes (FICA and self-employment tax) and the federal unemployment tax (FUTA) still apply in Puerto Rico.

source.title: Publication 570 (2025), Tax Guide for Individuals With Income From U.S. Territories
Publication 570 (2025), Tax Guide for Individuals With Income From U.S. Territories

sections.title: Freelancers, contractors and the self-employed

rows.label: Optional tax for the self-employed (contribución opcional, Sección 1021.06)
rows.value: Optional tax on gross income for self-employed individuals instead of the regular income tax: 6% (gross income up to $100,000), 10% (to $200,000), 13% (to $300,000), 15% (to $400,000), 17% (to $500,000), 20% (over $500,000); the rate for the bracket applies to the whole gross income. At least 80% of gross income must come from services subject to withholding.

rows.label: Tax status: own income tax system; US federal FICA and FUTA apply
rows.value: Puerto Rico has its own separate and independent income tax system (the Código de Rentas Internas de Puerto Rico de 2011, administered by the Departamento de Hacienda). Bona fide residents pay Puerto Rico income tax on worldwide income and generally report to the IRS only income from outside Puerto Rico; US federal social security and Medicare taxes (FICA and self-employment tax) and the federal unemployment tax (FUTA) still apply in Puerto Rico.

rows.label: Optional tax for the self-employed (contribución opcional, Sección 1021.06)
rows.value: Optional tax on gross income for self-employed individuals instead of the regular income tax: 6% (gross income up to $100,000), 10% (to $200,000), 13% (to $300,000), 15% (to $400,000), 17% (to $500,000), 20% (over $500,000); the rate for the bracket applies to the whole gross income. At least 80% of gross income must come from services subject to withholding.
